name: print-social-crimson-navy-cream-geometric-circle-grid-square-post-template
title: Crimson, Navy and Cream Circle Grid Template
whatItIs: A stock-template preview of a square post with a white left half holding a logo, 'it's a creative SOCIAL MEDIA POST TEMPLATE', a URL, a black CLICK HERE button and a phone number, beside a stepped stack of squares in crimson, navy and cream each holding a circle, bullseye or half-disc.
whatItMeans: A Bauhaus-style grid of simple circles gives a lively, playful pattern from very few shapes.
techniques: Stepped block layout of colour squares
Circles, rings and dots as the only motifs
Three-colour palette of crimson, navy and cream
Light and bold weights mixed in the headline
Black button as a strong anchor

vocabulary.definition: Squares arranged in a staircase edge.
A circle with a smaller ring and dot at its centre.
Design built from basic shapes and primary colours.
